game.title: XCOM: Chimera Squad
game.blurb: Turn-based squad tactics game set in City 31, from Firaxis (published by 2K Games), released 2020-04-23. RAWG average playtime: 4 hours. Genre: Strategy. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign

chapters.title: The Three Investigations
chapters.summary: The Gray Phoenix, Sacred Coil and Progeny investigations, and every version of each faction's Takedown mission.

chapters.title: Agents and Androids
chapters.summary: Each agent's signature move (Godmother, Terminal, Verge, Claymore, Blueblood, Patchwork, Shelter, Zephyr, Torque and Axiom), class training, ranks, a full squad and Androids.

chapters.title: City 31 and Headquarters
chapters.summary: Field Teams in all nine districts, Assembly Projects, the Scavenger Market, Spec Ops, Epic Weapons and Field Abilities.

chapters.title: Breaches and Tactics
chapters.summary: Breach points, clearing rooms on the Breach turn, capturing enemies, melee-only and no-kill missions, and Kinetic Armor.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "XCOM: Chimera Squad" or "XCOM Chimera Squad". xcom.fandom.com answers the API under "XCOM: Chimera Squad" with about 19 linked pages (City 31, the agent pages and a few others); names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 40 Steam achievements is hidden. The Steam schema gives no game name for app 882100; the store list confirms it as "XCOM®: Chimera Squad". Steam API names are just NEW_ACHIEVEMENT_0 to _39. "Army of One" (one Agent left standing) and "Need a Lift" (Shelter and Torque) land in the agents chapter because they name agents. Investigation order in the chapter follows the Steam list, not necessarily play order (the order may vary per campaign; not checked). RAWG's playtime of 4 hours looks low.
